messages.subject: Short Question to Unit-Non-Response
parts:
Hi

I ran a longitudinal study with 5 measurement Point (T1-T5)  and came to the question what the better way is to deal with Unit-Non-Responses.

At T1 I have 213
At T2 I have 199
At T3 I have 177
At T4 I have 150
At T5 I have 148

completely filled out surveys. (Full cases)

Maybe a simple question but I did the ML Estimation when running the SEM.

Is there a way doing a multiple Imputation, so that I would get 5 times a full dataset of 213 cases or is Multiple Imputation only used wenn having Item-Non-Responses?

Thanks for your answer.
